title: Many logical task codes in a shared LoReFT subspace
hypothesis: For exactly aligned rank-four hidden-state interventions, a shared LoReFT-style subspace with one four-value coordinate per task will preserve every tested function as logical task count grows from 1 to 256 and use no more than 0.30x the actual bytes of independent rank-four interventions by eight tasks.
physical_object: One frozen identity hidden map and one shared rank-four left/right intervention subspace.
mirror_coordinate: A persistent four-value task code m_t selecting coefficients on four shared rank-one transformation modes.
logical_multiplicity: An explicit bank of 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 or 256 independently selected task functions; only actually evaluated task IDs count.
controls: ordinary native shared LoReFT subspace plus task coefficients (same algebra and implementation as Mirror)

task.type: synthetic aligned hidden-state linear function bank
task.construction: Delta_t=U diag(c_t) V^T for one shared orthonormal U/V and independently seeded coefficient rows; target y=(I+Delta_t)x.
metrics: number of exactly unique stored task codes/functions
actual serialized bytes per bank and per task

development.task_count_sweep: all nine registered values; no selection or post-run tuning
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: Prohibited without numbered amendment; source frozen before opening seeds.

fresh.opening_rule: Only open if exact-function quality and byte gates pass and candidate differs usefully from the native shared-coefficient implementation; exact native identity closes Mirror attribution.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: independent per-task factors or full matrices
storage.base_identity_map: parameter-free and common to all controls; excluded from incremental intervention bytes

compute.proxy: rank-r update costs 2*D*r+r scalar multiply/adds per input; full matrix costs D*D

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: relative output RMSE <=1e-4 at every task count, all T task codes are unique, and by T>=8 shared payload <=0.30x independent rank-four bytes. Mirror-specific adoption additionally requires a useful measured margin over native shared coefficients.
gates.FAIL: Exact functions/bytes replay, but byte frontier misses or native shared LoReFT coefficients exactly explain the result without Mirror-specific margin.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent full-matrix upper or payload replay fails.

boundaries: Aligned synthetic rank-four functions only; this is a storage/logical-index scaling upper, not natural task capacity.
No code combinations or hypothetical addresses beyond evaluated task IDs count toward multiplicity.
This is a LoReFT-style low-rank representation intervention, not a full Transformer/ReFT training experiment.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless frozen gates and distinct native attribution support replication.
